failure_types.F01: grounding drift: the answer claims more than the retrieved text supports (ownership, launch status, invented figures).
failure_types.F02: chunk boundary: the fact is in the KB but buried inside a chunk about something else.
failure_types.F03: dark chunk: the right chunk exists but never ranks for the question (clinic: embedding mismatch).
failure_types.F04: reindex is not a deployment: a reader serves an old index or retired wording (clinic: index staleness).
failure_types.F05: follow-up rewrite misalignment: the multi-turn query rewrite retrieves the wrong thing.
failure_types.F06: long-chain drift: later turns drift from or build on earlier wrong turns.
failure_types.F07: tool misuse: kept for numbering; this pipeline has one retrieval call, no tool choice.
failure_types.F08: session context loss: a follow-up loses what earlier turns established.
failure_types.F09: eval blind spot: a check misses a real failure (T2.3/T2.4 checker misses).
failure_types.F10: startup ordering: a reader caches faiss_db at process start and was not restarted.
failure_types.F11: config drift: duplicated logic diverges (run_eval.py vs system-prompt.ts, api_server vs server_faiss).
failure_types.F12: source wording: the KB text itself states or implies something false. Replaces the clinic's multi-tenant interference, which does not apply here.

multiturn.note: Added 2026-10-19 (answer-quality-plan.md step 1). Held OUTSIDE 'questions' so the 34-question series stays comparable. Run with: run_eval.py --multiturn. Each conversation replays the model's own earlier answers, citation-stripped, as the site's client does. Retrieval per turn mirrors route.ts (search_query() in run_eval.py). No expect lists: these test behaviour across turns, not retrieval of named chunks. CAVEAT: T2.2 runs against the current turn's context only, so a figure correctly carried over from an earlier turn reads as unsupported. Read the spans before calling it a failure. 'human' is what a person scores; only T2.4 (M04) and T2.6 (M05) are automatic beyond the per-turn T1/T2 checks.
